info.name: CRM - Contract Generation Bot
info.description:
Every contract endpoint, in the order the SAP BPA bot calls them.

Set the collection variables first:
  baseUrl   - http://localhost:8080
  email     - a CRM login
  password  - its password
  dealId    - deals.id of a deal in PROPOSAL, NEGOTIATION or CLOSED_WON

"1. Login" stores the access token, and "2. Generate contract" stores contractId,
so the later requests need no manual copying.

item.name: 1. Login (existing CRM auth - not part of this module)

exec: pm.test('202 accepted, 201 finished inline, 200 absorbed retry', () => pm.expect([200, 201, 202]).to.include(pm.response.code));
if (pm.response.code === 202) { pm.test('DRAFTING while the render runs', () => pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('DRAFTING')); }
pm.test('carries the four fields the workflow consumes', () => {

request.description:
dealId is deals.id - the value GET /api/deals returns as `id`, NOT opportunityId ("OPP-000031") and NOT accountId.

GENERATION IS ASYNCHRONOUS. This returns in about a second, before the documents exist, because SAP BPA abandons an HTTP call at 30 seconds and a cold render takes longer.

202 Accepted - reserved and queued. status is DRAFTING and pdfUrl/docxUrl are null. Poll "3. Get contract status" until it reads GENERATED (usually 25-40s) or FAILED.
201 Created - rendered inline and finished. Only when contract.async-generation=false.
200 OK - an existing live contract was returned because this was a retry.

Body is identical in all three.

Validation still happens on this call, so these are unchanged:
400 missing billing address / no contact with an email / no owner / zero value
404 no such deal in this organization
409 deal is in an ineligible stage
500 DOCX, PDF or storage failure - SYNCHRONOUS MODE ONLY. Asynchronously the contract goes to FAILED with the reason in failureReason, which GET /api/contracts/{id} returns.

item.name: 2b. Generate with explicit template and terms

body.raw:
{
  "dealId": {{dealId}},
  "contractType": "PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES_AGREEMENT",
  "startDate": "2026-10-01",
  "endDate": "2027-10-01",
  "paymentTerms": "Net 45 from invoice date.",
  "deliveryTimeline": "Phase 1 within 30 days of kickoff.",
  "regenerate": true
}

request.description:
regenerate:true supersedes the deal's existing live contract and drafts a new one. Refused with 409 if that contract is already SIGNED.

contractType is one of STANDARD_SALES_AGREEMENT, ENTERPRISE_SUBSCRIPTION_AGREEMENT, PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES_AGREEMENT. Omit it to let the resolver choose.

exec: pm.test('a retry is absorbed with 200, not a second contract', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Run immediately after "2. Generate contract". Proves the automation platform's retry does not produce a second contract for the same opportunity.
The whole record: customer and contact, sales executive, template used, status, frozen line items, document URLs, signing information.

The small shape the bot polls while it waits for a signature.

GENERATED -> SENT -> VIEWED -> SIGNED | REJECTED, plus FAILED and SUPERSEDED.
Every contract in the caller's organization, newest first.

Run once "4. Get contract status" reads GENERATED. Emails the customer the contract PDF as an attachment, sent by the backend through Mailjet, and marks the contract and the deal SENT.

The body is optional - with no body it goes to the contract's contact. Demo contacts use @example.com, which never receives mail, so put a real address in recipientEmail for testing. Set resend: true to send again (e.g. after editing backend/email-templates/).

200 { contractId, contractNumber, status: SENT | ALREADY_SENT, sentTo, mailjetMessageId, attachmentBytes, sentAt }
400 no recipient address
404 no such contract in your organization
409 no PDF, or contract still DRAFTING / not current (FAILED, SUPERSEDED, SIGNED, REJECTED)
502 Mailjet refused it - reason in the audit log (CONTRACT_EMAIL_FAILED)
503 mailjet.* not configured on the server

200 application/pdf, Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="CTR-000042.pdf", Cache-Control: no-store.

404 when the contract has no PDF (LibreOffice disabled) or the file has gone missing from the store.
401 without a token - documents are never public.
